# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Added the evolutionary architecture doctrine across architecture, engineering-rule, implementation-planning, implementation-artifact, and reviewer skills. Generated plans now map approved future capabilities to existing authorities, admit only expensive-to-retrofit seams exercised by a current flow, reject later parallel systems and speculative frameworks, and validate liveness, bypass, retirement, and killer-mutation proof.
- Added `$specforge-discovery-interview` to make the client-intake/product-discovery phase explicit, ordered, and decision-matrix driven before SpecForge generates docs. The subskill now uses an infer-before-asking workflow and a large question repository so interviews adapt to previous answers instead of asking every question.
- Added `$specforge-implementation-artifacts` for the post-docs implementation-artifact phase.
- Added `validate_implementation_artifacts.py` so implementation packs are checked for required artifacts, source-to-surface coverage, traceability, research basis, evidence paths, slice completeness, verification gates, rollback, observability, documentation updates, prompt safety, and AI decision matrices when applicable.
- Added canonical generated-doc folder layout so product docs, assurance docs, implementation docs, and auditability/meta docs are separated instead of dumped into `docs/app-plan/`.

## 1.2.0

- Generalized the trust extension into proportional assurance architecture.
- Added assurance tiers so simple apps are not forced to produce filler docs.
- Replaced AI-first rules with decision-owner rules for human, policy, provider, deterministic, and AI-owned decisions.
- Added `--assurance` validation mode.
- Removed product-specific lesson assumptions from the public skill pack.
